title: hieracium angustatum subsp. ovulatum
intro: Hieracium angustatum subsp. ovulatum, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as improving cardiovascular health and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium angustatum subsp. ovulatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have been reported to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential applications of this plant.
